proposals.prompt:
Agents in a supermarket gridworld must collect their required items and leave through the exit. Every action costs the same, so demonstrators prefer short trajectories -- unless an unknown social norm makes them behave otherwise. Your task is to propose candidate norms (obligations or prohibitions) that could explain the demonstrated behaviour.
Each demonstration is listed step by step as  `k: {atoms true in the state} action`.

Available atoms:
- at(x,y) -- the agent is at cell (x,y); x = column (0 = left), y = row (0 = top); N decreases y, S increases y, E increases x, W decreases x
- hasCart -- the agent is holding/pushing a shopping cart
- actions N, S, E, W, MOVE (any of the four moves), INTERACT (any interaction with an object: the different kinds of interaction are NOT distinguished), EXIT (leave the store; always the last action)

Demonstration 1 (required items: s1):
  0: {at(0,7)} E
  1: {at(1,7)} INTERACT
  2: {at(1,7), hasCart} E
  3: {at(2,7), hasCart} E
  4: {at(3,7), hasCart} E
  5: {at(4,7), hasCart} E
  6: {at(5,7), hasCart} E
  7: {at(6,7), hasCart} N
  8: {at(6,6), hasCart} INTERACT
  9: {at(6,6), hasCart} E
 10: {at(7,6), hasCart} E
 11: {at(8,6), hasCart} S
 12: {at(8,7), hasCart} E
 13: {at(9,7), hasCart} E
 14: {at(10,7), hasCart} E
 15: {at(11,7), hasCart} EXIT
 16: {at(11,7), hasCart} <terminal>

Propose norms using ONLY the atoms listed above. Do NOT define any new state properties or events: "abstraction" must be {}.
Propose 8 diverse candidate hypotheses.

Output format: return ONLY a JSON list (no prose, no code fences). Each element:
{"id": short_name, "text": one-sentence natural-language statement of the norm,
 "abstraction": {"state_properties": {name: FORMULA, ...},
                 "events": {name: {"pre": FORMULA, "post": FORMULA or null}, ...}},
 "norm": {"type": "prohibition", "condition": FORMULA}
       | {"type": "obligation", "trigger": FORMULA or "START", "discharge": FORMULA}}
FORMULA := atom | name of a property/event defined in this hypothesis | {"not": F} | {"and": [F, ...]}
         | {"or": [F, ...]} | {"le"|"lt"|"ge"|"gt"|"eq": [numeric_feature, integer]}
Semantics.  A trajectory is a sequence of steps (state s_k, action a_k).  A step's label contains the atoms true in
s_k and the action a_k.  A state property is a formula over state atoms (no actions).  An event
{"pre": P, "post": Q} occurs at step k when P holds for the label of step k and Q holds in the next state s_{k+1}
(post may be null).  A prohibition counts one violation for every step whose label (including events occurring at
that step) satisfies the condition.  An obligation becomes pending at any step satisfying the trigger ("START" =
pending from the beginning) and is fulfilled by a later (or the same) step satisfying the discharge; it can be
triggered again; it is violated if it is still pending when the trajectory ends.

parsed.text: The agent is obliged to obtain a shopping cart during the trip.
The agent is prohibited from leaving the store without a shopping cart.
The agent is obliged to interact with the cart station at cell (1,7).
The agent is prohibited from entering the main shopping path beyond the cart bay without a cart.
The agent is prohibited from moving north or south unless they have a cart.
The agent is prohibited from interacting at cell (6,6) without a cart.
The agent is prohibited from interacting anywhere except at the cart location or the item location.
The agent is prohibited from moving west, as if the store has a one-way walking rule.

parsed.text: Shopping carts must not be taken into single-file shelf aisles, where there is only one free cell of horizontal clearance.
A shopper pushing a cart is forbidden from moving into a single-file shelf aisle.
Shelf interactions inside a single-file aisle must be performed without a cart.
After returning from a cart-free single-file aisle to its mouth, the shopper must retrieve the cart before continuing.
After collecting an item from a single-file shelf aisle without a cart, the shopper must return to the aisle mouth where the cart was left.
Carts may only be picked up or put down at designated cart-parking points such as the entrance cart station or the mouth of a narrow aisle.
Except at the entrance/cart station or a narrow-aisle parking mouth, shoppers should not move through wide open aisles without their cart.
When interacting with a shelf from a broad aisle face rather than a single-file aisle, the shopper must have a cart.

Semantics.  A trajectory is a sequence of steps (state s_k, action a_k).  A step's label contains the atoms true in
s_k and the action a_k.  A state property is a formula over state atoms (no actions).  An event
{"pre": P, "post": Q} occurs at step k when P holds for the label of step k and Q holds in the next state s_{k+1}
(post may be null).  A prohibition counts one violation for every step whose label (including events occurring at

parsed.text: Shopping carts must not be taken into single-file shelf aisles, where there is only one free cell of horizontal clearance.
A shopper pushing a cart is forbidden from moving into a single-file shelf aisle.
Shelf interactions inside a single-file aisle must be performed without a cart.
After returning from a cart-free single-file aisle to its mouth, the shopper must retrieve the cart before continuing.
After collecting an item from a single-file shelf aisle without a cart, the shopper must return to the aisle mouth where the cart was left.
Carts may only be picked up or put down at designated cart-parking points such as the entrance cart station or the mouth of a narrow aisle.
Except at the entrance/cart station or a narrow-aisle parking mouth, shoppers should not move through wide open aisles without their cart.
When interacting with a shelf from a broad aisle face rather than a single-file aisle, the shopper must have a cart.

accepted.description: [g1_no_carts_in_single_file_shelf_aisles] FORBIDDEN: (hasCart ∧ singleFileShelfAisle)  where singleFile := freeWidthH≤1; singleFileShelfAisle := (singleFile ∧ adjShelf)
[g1_no_entering_single_file_with_cart] FORBIDDEN: enterSingleFileWithCart  where singleFileShelfAisle := (freeWidthH≤1 ∧ adjShelf); enterSingleFileWithCart := (hasCart ∧ MOVE) · singleFileShelfAisle

[g1_no_cart_shelf_service_in_single_file] FORBIDDEN: (shelfServiceInSingleFile ∧ hasCart)  where singleFileShelfAisle := (freeWidthH≤1 ∧ adjShelf); shelfServiceInSingleFile := (INTERACT ∧ singleFileShelfAisle)

[g1_retrieve_cart_after_returning_from_narrow_aisle] OBLIGED: after returnToMouthWithoutCart, eventually pickupCartAtMouth (before exit)  where atMouthWithoutCart := (narrowAisleMouth ∧ noCart); narrowAisleMouth := at(3,3); noCart := ¬hasCart; singleFileShelfAisle := (freeWidthH≤1 ∧ adjShelf); pickupCartAtMouth := (narrowAisleMouth ∧ noCart ∧ INTERACT) · hasCart; returnToMouthWithoutCart := (singleFileShelfAisle ∧ noCart ∧ S) · atMouthWithoutCart

[g1_return_to_cart_mouth_after_narrow_item] OBLIGED: after takeNarrowAisleItemWithoutCart, eventually atMouthWithoutCart (before exit)  where atMouthWithoutCart := (narrowAisleMouth ∧ noCart); narrowAisleMouth := at(3,3); noCart := ¬hasCart; singleFileShelfAisle := (freeWidthH≤1 ∧ adjShelf); takeNarrowAisleItemWithoutCart := (INTERACT ∧ singleFileShelfAisle ∧ noCart)

[g1_cart_transfers_only_at_parking_points] FORBIDDEN: ((dropCart ∨ pickupCart) ∧ ¬cartParkingPoint)  where cartParkingPoint := (cartStation ∨ narrowAisleMouth); cartStation := at(1,7); narrowAisleMouth := at(3,3); noCart := ¬hasCart; dropCart := (hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · noCart; pickupCart := (noCart ∧ INTERACT) · hasCart

[g1_no_roaming_open_aisles_without_cart] FORBIDDEN: (¬hasCart ∧ wideOpenAisle ∧ MOVE ∧ ¬allowedCartlessWideArea)  where allowedCartlessWideArea := (cartStationArea ∨ narrowAisleMouth); cartStationArea := (at(0,7) ∨ at(1,7)); narrowAisleMouth := at(3,3); wideOpenAisle := freeWidthH≥12

[g1_cart_required_for_broad_shelf_faces] FORBIDDEN: (broadShelfInteraction ∧ ¬hasCart)  where broadShelfFace := (adjShelf ∧ ¬singleFile); singleFile := freeWidthH≤1; broadShelfInteraction := (INTERACT ∧ broadShelfFace)
